Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

Location Note

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards.

This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities.
  • You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations.
  • You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities.
  • You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation.
  • You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards.
  • You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships.
  • You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up.
  • You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices.
  • You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes.
  • You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio.
  • You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review.
  • You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis.

You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods.
  • Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows.
  • Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools.
  • Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use.
  • Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in model risk management or independent model validation.
  • Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment.
  • Familiarity with model governance frameworks, model inventories, risk tiering, validation schedules, issue management, or regulatory expectations.
  • Experience validating machine learning or AI models.
  • Experience developing or validating liquidity, funding, or cash-flow forecasting models, including evaluating funding needs and liquidity under stress scenarios.
  • Familiarity with capital markets models used for loan valuation or securitization, including assessing how key assumptions affect valuations and projected cash flows.Experience with AWS, SageMaker, Databricks, or other cloud-based analytics and modeling platforms.
  • Experience with Spark, PySpark, Hive, or other large-scale data technologies.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to support research, coding, documentation, validation, or quantitative analysis.

 

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

India Benefits:

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

Provident Fund

Life & Accident Insurance

Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

 

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

 

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).
